target.contig_interpretation: Variable scaffold segments flank and connect the seven preserved input-PDB motif residues; the motif residues are copied from chain A and the terminal 50-70 segment is the generated scaffold extension.

success_criterion.bar_basis: Watson et al. Nature 620 (2023) defines in-silico motif-scaffolding success using AF2-to-design RMSD <2 A, motif RMSD <1 A and pAE <5; the paper evaluates 100 designs per problem and reports problem-level performance rather than a directly transferable per-pair rate. For this bounded 64-pair smoke campaign, 20% is pre-registered as a conservative operational floor, close to the 19% experimental binder success rate reported across five targets, and is not a claim of experimental equivalence.

scope_statement: A passing design means only that the RFdiffusion backbone, ProteinMPNN sequence, and Boltz-2 refold were computationally self-consistent at the pre-registered RMSD thresholds. It does not show folding, stability, expression, binding, function, or biological success. pLDDT, pTM, and scRMSD are not biological-property evidence.
